name: Strike True Combat
body:
Rather than attempting a series of wild blows, you line up a perfect attack.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): You can focus yourself as a move action. When focused, you gain a +4 bonus on your next melee attack roll before the end of your turn.
